purpose: Dated staff grades of defense for players without a DBPM record. The engine reads a grade for games on or after its date as the player's defensive value (points per 100 possessions) and as his perimeter_defense rating; a played game keeps the inputs it was played with.

evidence: profile sections 6 and 14: base 45 (length and strength for guard matchups, weak-side blocks and deflections; loses cutters, leaves shooters to help, caught on screens)
No assignment-level defensive evidence; preseason steals and blocks do not change this grade.
players.basis: grade 50 is an average defender; 1.0 point per 100 possessions per ten grade points (runtime/camp.py)
